MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | DevOps / Platform Engineering
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including substantial hands-on work in CI/CD, test infrastructure and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and merge-request ephemeral environments for three product teams. Brings practical Docker, Helm and Kubernetes experience within a namespace-level scope, plus personal k3s/GitOps infrastructure and Terraform provisioning for a Hetzner VPS. Seeking a full-time transition into DevOps or platform engineering.

CORE SKILLS
Infrastructure and CI/CD: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level shared-cluster access; k3s homelab), Argo CD
Infrastructure as code and automation: Terraform (personal VPS provisioning), Ansible (basic), Bash, Python
Observability and systems: Linux, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, Git
Testing and quality: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman, SQL
Cloud learning: AWS EC2 and S3 fundamentals (personal learning)

EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | Wroclaw | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (~25 developers), covering build, unit/integration/e2e test stages and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline duration from 38 to 14 minutes through parallel jobs, dependency caching and separating e2e execution; reduced monthly CI runner costs by about 30%.
- Built short-lived merge-request environments (application, PostgreSQL and seeded data) deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. CI removes environments automatically after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use them for reviews and e2e tests.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright e2e suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding and used the GitLab API, PostgreSQL and Grafana to surface flaky-test metrics.
- Authored internal CI documentation used for onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins jobs for nightly runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | Wroclaw | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases, reproducing bugs for developers.

SELECTED PROJECT
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Ran a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, deploying applications from a Git repository with Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): studying; exam scheduled for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor - Fleet Connectivity role. I bring seven years of QA engineering experience and a current focus on CI/CD and test infrastructure, and I am deliberately moving into DevOps and platform engineering. The opportunity to help build infrastructure for Corvale's new train fleet from early design toward production is a strong fit for the direction I am pursuing.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three teams and built per-merge-request environments using Docker and Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster. These environments include application services, PostgreSQL and seeded data, run end-to-end tests, and are automatically removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity. I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. I also maintain approximately 900 end-to-end tests and helped reduce the flaky rate from 7% to below 1%. This work has strengthened my practical approach to automation, repeatability and making systems easier for engineering teams to use.

My hands-on infrastructure work so far is concentrated on CI and test environments rather than operating a production cloud platform. The shared Kubernetes cluster is run by a platform team, and my access is at namespace level. In my personal homelab, I run k3s with Argo CD and Prometheus, Grafana and Loki; I have also provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform. My AWS exposure is personal learning with EC2 and S3, not production experience. I am currently studying for the CKA, with the exam scheduled for January 2027.

I would bring a track record of improving delivery pipelines, building useful environments for developers and documenting technical systems for others. I am interested in applying that foundation to reliable, observable infrastructure for Corvale's fleet connectivity work. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the team.

Sincerely,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
